text:
olivia_support: FYI escalation from Acme — promo code ACME-DEMO-2026 applied to their hosted project `acme-dev` instead of their Dedicated reservation `acme-enterprise-dedicated`. Customer already spent ~75% of credits and is now hitting hosted rate limits. Need to move remaining credits to Dedicated ASAP. tenant: tenant_acme_778, customer ticket: CUST-9124

sam_billing: can you drop the promo code and tenant id again and confirm which SKU the grant was supposed to land on?

olivia_support: Promo: ACME-DEMO-2026, intended SKU: `dedicated-enterprise-monthly` (reserved capacity). Currently showing applied to project `acme-dev` (hosted).

josh_engineer: rough repro steps from billing UI? I want to see allocation_id and amount.

olivia_support: In billing UI -> Allocations -> search tenant_acme_778 -> shows allocation_id `alloc_0a1b2c3d`, amount 10,000 token credits, applied_to `project:acme-dev`.

kevin_pm: @finance we need an off-cycle allocation reassign and a temporary hosted rate limit raise while we move credits. Please approve FIN-3284.

devex_sam: I can run the reassign script once finance approves. Script (dry-run):
```
# reassign allocation from hosted project to dedicated reservation
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/v1/billing/reassign" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"allocation_id":"alloc_0a1b2c3d","target_type":"reservation","target_id":"res_acme_enterprise_01"}'
```

sre_bot: Temporary measure: I can bump hosted rate limits for `acme-dev` for 6 hours to reduce customer impact if allowed. :white_check_mark:

maria_support: I ran a quick audit — promo was issued by channel partner onboarding flow and the mapping step didn't surface due to a missing `reservation_id` in the partner payload. Raising a bug with onboarding.

sam_billing: Finance approved FIN-3284 (OK by @kevin_pm). @devex_sam you have approval to run. Please post command output.

devex_sam: running in dry-run first, will post real output after confirmation. Dry-run output:
```
{ "status": "dry-run", "allocation_id":"alloc_0a1b2c3d", "would_move_to":"res_acme_enterprise_01" }
```

devex_sam: running now (real run)...

devex_sam: result: `success` — allocation `alloc_0a1b2c3d` reassigned -> `res_acme_enterprise_01`. New allocation record `alloc_9f8e7d6c`.

olivia_support: confirmed with customer — they can see credits in their Dedicated reservation console. Customer asked that we leave hosted bump until tomorrow, they handled traffic. :tada:

kevin_pm: filing follow-up with Partner Onboarding to add validation for `reservation_id`. Tracking: ENG-5821.

maria_support: marking CUST-9124 resolved on our side, will keep an eye for any billing sync diffs.

josh_engineer: leaving a short playbook in internal KB for this situation (how to reassign allocations + temporary rate bump).
